scene: standing before a dark unlit lighthouse at night, salt wind pulling at his coat
an old brass storm-lantern glowing faint amber in fog, close-up still life
hands gripping a rail, knuckles white, ghostly repeated afterimages of the same gesture
eight identical fresh graves in a row under a folding starless sky, one open and empty
a tall wrong silhouette at the far end of an empty street, too many angles, not quite arriving, featureless, dread, negative space
